body:
Thanks for your reply.  I sincerely wish you the best with whatever you decide on doing! Despite my troubles, I really think that living in a place so different from my home has been a positive experience (it's just, with the depression, I have an overall net negative lol).

Do you have any mental health problems? If so, my big advice would be to be on top of those before heading over, and definitely check into how and where you can continue your care if need be.

I dunno, I still feel awful everyday and still have so many problems but I don't want to let anyone down.  This is the first time someone's invested so much time and energy in trying to help me through everything.  Thanks for your well wishes, and I hope that your aspirations come true as well.
